crawl.note: The homepage names Credit Cards and links to https://www.aub.com.ph/creditcards/, which redirected to https://online.aub.ph/creditcards (host not in official_domains). The listing was not read.

First full crawl 2026-11-24: 13 consumer credit cards and 267 credit-card offers from the official Credit cards promo tab (284 unique tiles: 14 expired before the run date, 1 official URL hit a redirect loop, 2 hub pages skipped, 267 handed in). listing_complete is false because the rewards catalogue under /personal/rewards-and-promotions (points redemption hubs) was not fully read as offer pages, and https://www.bpi.com.ph/personal/rewards-and-promotions/promos/robinsons-appliances-flexipayzero returned a redirect loop. The official cards page also links to https://www2.bpi.com.ph/cards/pq/landing and to https://www.banko.com.ph/ for BanKo; those hosts are not in official_domains. Corporate was excluded. BPI Family Credit Card is named only on the rates table (no product page). BPI DOS Card appears in offer eligibility (Robinsons Bank merger) but has no consumer product page. eCredit is closed to new applications from 30 Nov 2024. Amore Platinum Cashback is being rebranded to Robinsons Cashback effective 24 Jun 2026.
Offer links also point at offers.hsbc.com.ph and www.homeandaway.hsbc.com, which are not in official_domains.

The official homepage states Apply for a credit card and links to https://apply.metrobank.com.ph/creditcard. That host is not in official_domains. No on-host card listing URL was found on the homepage.

Real-Chrome mode reached the official cards catalogue, which lists Credit, Debit and Prepaid categories and names PNB Credit Cards and the PNB-PAL Mabuhay Miles Mastercard Credit Card. The fetcher classed the homepage and catalogue captcha because the HTML includes a reCAPTCHA v3 script and badge; the public catalogue text was present and was used. No challenge was interacted with. The cards page links to https://www.pnb.com.ph/promos; this run did not return readable promo listing text.
The official site has a RCBC Credit Cards link to https://rcbccredit.com/, which is not in official_domains. The listing was not read.
